title: orthochilus subulatus
intro: Orthochilus subulatus, commonly known as the Purple Orchid, is a flowering plant species in the family Orchidaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Orthochilus subulatus include its ability to act as an antioxidant and its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and viruses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
